content.title: Donate
content.summary: The Arvada City Council authorized the acceptance of gifts and grants for the Majestic View Nature Center in 2011, in partnership with the Jeffco Outdoors Foundation. Donations can support various needs, including program materials, garden tools, and interpretive signage, as well as larger projects aligned with the center's Strategic Plan. Contributions can be made through funds, materials, or volunteer time, and specific project donations are also welcomed.
content.body:
In 2011, the [Arvada City Council passed a resolution](https://library.municode.com/co/arvada/munidocs/munidocs?nodeId=a3f91ebd9e68) authorizing the acceptance of gifts and grants to the Majestic View Nature Center. Majestic View Nature Center also partners with the Jeffco Outdoors Foundation, a public non-profit organization that can accept donations and grants. For questions or concerns, please contact us.

## Things to Donate

### Donate Funds

Visitors can support the Nature Center by helping fund:

- Our program materials (workbooks/printing, craft supplies, magnifying glasses, binoculars, etc.)
- Tools, labels, or replacement plants for the demonstration garden
- New display development and materials (Sponsor a project an exhibit to have your name displayed in the Nature Center)
- Interpretive signage along trails (Sponsor a trail and have your name displayed on the sign)
- Nature Play and Outdoor Classroom elements for school, camp, and public programs (Lockable storage stations, tables and chairs, etc.)
- Larger donations (greater than $5,000) can support our efforts towards our Strategic Plan (including program expansions, additional trails, habitat restoration projects, and, wildlife conservation study, etc.).

[Donate on our Payment Portal](https://secure.rec1.com/CO/arvada-co/catalog "Donate on our secure payment Portal")

### Donate to a Specific Project

Donations restricted to a project will go into the project revenue. To restrict a donation, please provide a donation letter outlining the project you wish support and staff will work with you to accept your donation if approved. If you wish to provide general support to the Nature Center’s operations, please donate on our payment portal.

If you are able and willing, your support enables the Nature Center to keep moving forward towards our mission and is much appreciated. You can contact us for card, cash, check or other donations; or if your group would like to fundraise and sponsor a specific project, please let us know!

### Donate Materials

We are always in need of items to use for our classes, in the office, and for our exhibits. Some items are restricted or require permits to be donated. If you have items that you are unsure about, please ask us prior to bring the objects to the Nature Center (for example: large or protected taxidermy, technology devices, or vehicles will likely not be accepted).

Suggested donations are:

- [Home Depot Gift Cards](https://www.homedepot.com/c/Gift_Cards): Used to purchase program materials for camps, bird feeders, bee houses, art classes, field trips and more.
- Amazon Gift Cards: Used to purchase supplies for the office, programs, exhibits, and maintenance supplies. We've created an [Amazon Wish List](https://www.amazon.com/hz/wishlist/ls/1CBHQQMJQ4LQ2/ref=hz_ls_biz_ex) for specific items.

### Donate Time and Expertise

You can donate your time or your expertise in a variety of ways. To become a volunteer, [visit our volunteer page](/1113/Volunteer). If you have expertise you’d like to offer, please contact us to see if there is an active project available.
